review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Policy and Procedure Management: Develop, review, and maintain comprehensive IT policies, standards, and procedures, ensuring they are aligned with industry best practices, regulatory requirements (e.g., healthcare data privacy), and our organizational objectives.
